ai.title: Fix dynamic agent registry init timing
ai.summary: Spawn-agents now awaits dynamic agent registry initialization inside the trigger function, fixing race conditions where templates were unavailable. DynamicAgentService adds logging for successful loads and validation errors. CI staging workflow updated for PR #208. Release-staging script switches version check to npm registry.

eli5.text: The assistant used to grab its list of available sub-agents a little too early, so those sub-agents sometimes weren't ready when a task asked for them, now it waits until that list is fully set before doing anything. This affects internal staging builds on the 'prod' environment branch tied to pull request #208, which is what the team uses to preview changes before pushing them live. If you looked at the logs you'd see new entries confirming when sub-agents load successfully or when a template fails to validate, instead of silent failures.

ai.title: Fix dynamic agent initialization and validation flow
ai.summary: AgentRegistry.initialize now calls reset() on every invocation, clearing stale state and resetting the underlying DynamicAgentService. websocket-action.ts delegates dynamic agent loading and override validation to the registry, removing manual dynamicAgentService.loadAgents and validateAgentTemplateConfigs calls. Scope: backend templates, websocket init, shared validation util. Reset clears allAgentNames, isInitialized, and validationErrors before reloading templates.

eli5.text: When you connect to a project that uses custom (dynamic) agent templates, the system now fully resets and reloads those template definitions every single time instead of reusing potentially stale ones from a previous session. This means template validation errors are recalculated fresh each connection, so any fixes you made to a broken template will actually take effect on your next try, and previously cached invalid templates won't silently persist. The behind-the-scenes loading steps were also consolidated, so the validation flow is simpler and less prone to skipping checks.

ai.title: CLI discovers local agents from .agents/templates
ai.summary: CLI now scans .agents/templates/*.json to discover local agents. getLocalAgentNames reads filenames and name fields, merging results with built-in UNIQUE_AGENT_NAMES. @mention autocomplete and displayAgentMenu show local agents. Invalid JSON files are skipped.

eli5.text: When you start the tool, it now checks a hidden folder in your project for custom helper profiles you or your team have saved locally. Any profile found there appears alongside the built-in ones when you mention helpers or browse the menu, so you can pick your local ones just like the standard choices. If a saved profile file is malformed, it's simply ignored rather than causing an error.

ai.title: Version bump to 1.0.433
ai.summary: Release package version incremented to 1.0.433 in `npm-app/release/package.json`. Routine patch update.

eli5.text: If you install the latest version today, your coding assistant will load locally saved agent templates from a.agents folder on your machine, so custom agents you drop there show up automatically. Behind the scenes, the startup sequence now waits for all agent templates to be fully registered before launching agents, which prevents agents from failing to start because their tools weren't ready yet. The version label itself just moved from 1.0.432 to 1.0.433 to mark these updates being bundled together.

eli5.text: If you install or update the assistant program today, you'll get version 1.0.434, which is just a routine label change that keeps the program current. The program itself works the same as the previous update; this step only marks a new release number. Nothing you do or see changes, the assistant still starts up, writes code, and finishes tasks exactly as it did before this update.

ai.title: Remove dynamic agent override support
ai.summary: Dynamic agent loader now rejects `override: true` in JSON templates. `agent-overrides.ts` throws validation errors for flagged files, while `dynamic-agent-service.ts` surfaces these errors during template processing. Scope covers backend template loading logic. Migration requires setting `override: false` or removing the field entirely.

eli5.text: The assistant no longer allows custom agent templates to override its built-in instructions, anyone who had a template file with override: true will now see an error when the system tries to load it. This affects backend operators or developers using local template files, not end users chatting with the assistant. If you looked at the affected system today, you'd see validation messages rejecting templates that still try to override core behavior.

ai.title: Agent name normalization doc and validation refactor
ai.summary: Agent name normalization logic clarified to strip only default CodebuffAI/ prefix, preserving other org identities. Validation in agent-template-validation.ts refactored to normalize dynamic agent IDs and spawnable agents before comparison, removing redundant prefix-stripping steps. backend/knowledge.md updated with Agent System section detailing valid prefix-less references and key file locations.

eli5.text: You can now list agent names in your project templates without needing to include the "CodebuffAI/" prefix. The system strips that default prefix automatically when checking which agents you're allowed to use, but leaves any other organization prefix untouched so those agents keep their correct identity. This applies to agent templates placed in your project's ".agents/templates/" folder and how they reference other agents. It's live today.
